name: Gargantua entrance
doc: Gargantua's entrance (enemy attack 265, Gargantua c0m094, on itself; FFNx's burrow module): a layout on the ground at the caster, the module drawing its body with the polygons under the ground line left out and ground marks where it crosses it, rocks and dust puffs from a spawn stream, its colour faded back in at the end, the sound and its voice; no damage. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag301_gargantua_burrow.cpp) run on the program's memory (its master, rocks and puffs in the magic buffer); the spawn stream's pointer is exe data (never put back: a copy reads its own stream at the pointer's offset).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Master
parts.doc: The master's ticks, the start sound and the voice (claimed at the start, released near the end), the caster's colour faded back in at the end; the texture and the camera

parts.title: Layout
parts.doc: The prim-model layout at the caster's effect position (on the ground)

parts.title: Body
parts.doc: The caster drawn by the module: polygons all below the ground line left out, every n-th one crossing it leaving a ground mark

parts.title: Ground marks
parts.doc: A flipbook on the ground where the body crosses it

parts.title: Rocks
parts.doc: Rocks from the spawn stream: a mesh at the caster, thrown, spinning, falling and bouncing

parts.title: Dust
parts.doc: Dust puffs from the spawn stream: a flipbook drifting from the caster

groups.label: Colour fade
groups.doc: The caster's colour faded back in

params.label: Sound
params.doc: At the start sound's tick

params.label: Voice
params.doc: The sound block its voice slot is claimed with (at the start)

params.label: Sound

params.label: Voice released

params.label: End

params.doc: The rocks and puffs of each tick (0x12B8 bytes: a count, then 10 words a rock - offset x / y / z, velocity x / y / z, angle x / y, spin x / y; a count, then 6 words a puff - offset, velocity; edit their numbers, keep their shape)

params.label: Texture file

params.label: Camera track
params.doc: The camera track its setup plays (any length: its offsets are its own)
